decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mention to a dedicated page and it is close to the firm's core integration business, so results likely meet or are near aspiration levels and the firm has enough slack to continue learning from it.

As a framework line it is strategically related to the firm's development and platform work, but the weaker website prominence than some other launches suggests more uncertain market traction and therefore a higher, though not dominant, chance of withdrawal.
The move to a dedicated page and the clear fit with enterprise user-management integration indicate favorable feedback relative to aspirations, making retention the likely choice.

This workshop is very new and demand is still being tested, but because it builds directly on established consulting and training capabilities the firm is likely to keep it for another year unless early sales clearly disappoint.
